entities.name: Dragan Maršićanin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dragan Maršićanin is a Serbian economist and politician. He was the ambassador of Serbia to Switzerland from 2004 to 2009. He served as the Minister of Economy in 2004, only to leave it in order to run for president in 2004. He later resigned from the position and was replaced by Predrag Bubalo in October 2004.
